notes: Every control is optional: a key that is absent is "not set" and the app uses its built-in default.
"default" is the starting value Moonbase offers when an admin turns the control on; absent when Moonbase starts it unset.
"storeAs": "string" means the client stores a numeric slider value as text.
"alsoKeys" are further keys that Moonbase writes with the same value as "key".

controls.label: Apply Rating Limit to Recommendations
controls.help: Filter recommendations to not exceed the current item's age rating.

controls.label: Confirm Exit (TV clients only)
controls.help: Ask before the back button leaves the app.

controls.label: Bottom Bar Style
controls.help: Phones and tablets with the Bottom navigation style.

controls.label: Bottom Bar Tabs
controls.help: Up to three tabs between Home and You. Left unset, each device picks them from the Nav Buttons below, and everything else shows in the You menu.

controls.label: Interface Style
controls.help: Automatic adapts to your device. Choose Apple or Material to lock the look.

controls.label: App Theme
controls.help: Default overall app style. Keep Not set to let users choose.

controls.label: Focus Border Color
controls.help: Color used for focused cards and controls.

controls.label: Seasonal Row Hidden Holidays
controls.help: Holidays whose row is hidden for users who have not chosen for themselves.

controls.label: Screensaver Component Position
controls.help: Applies when the component movement is Static.

controls.label: Screensaver Content Type
controls.help: What the Library Art backdrop shows.

controls.label: Screensaver Libraries
controls.help: IDs of the libraries the screensaver draws from. Empty means all libraries.

controls.label: Screensaver Collections
controls.help: IDs of the collections the screensaver draws from.

controls.label: Screensaver Excluded Genres
controls.help: Genre names the screensaver never shows.

controls.label: Merge Continue Watching and Next Up
controls.help: Combine Continue Watching and Next Up into a single home row by default.

controls.label: Max days in Next Up
controls.help: How long a show stays in Next Up after it was last watched.

controls.label: Merge Recent Rows by Type
controls.help: Combines recently added media from different libraries of the same type into unified rows.

controls.label: Recently Released Series Sort By
controls.help: Sort Recently Released Series home rows by series, latest season, or latest episode air date. Toggle the switches for these home row categories to make them available in the home sections page by default.

controls.label: Since You Watched Includes Watched Items
Trailer Captions
controls.help: Show closed captions on YouTube trailers when available.

controls.label: Media Bar Libraries
controls.help: Library IDs, used when the Media Bar Source is "library".

controls.label: Media Bar Collections
controls.help: Collection IDs, used when the Media Bar Source is "collection".

controls.label: Media Bar Excluded Genres
controls.help: Genres the media bar never shows.

controls.label: Modern cards on My Media row
controls.help: Display customizable posters that expand on focus. Disable to always show landscape thumbnail.

controls.label: Override Row Image Type
controls.help: Use one image type for every home row instead of each row choosing its own.

controls.label: Row Image Type
controls.help: The artwork each home row uses with the Classic row type. Only applies while Override Row Image Type is off. Continue Watching has its own setting above. A row left unset is up to the user.

controls.label: Preview Audio
controls.help: Chart rows the home sections page can offer. IMDb rows need IMDb Charts enabled above, TMDB rows need a TMDB API key.

controls.label: Per-Row Image Types
controls.help: Comma-separated row:type pairs, for example "nextup:thumb,latestmedia:poster". Types: poster, thumb, banner. Only applies while Override Row Image Type is off.

controls.label: Seasonal Row
controls.help: A Home row of holiday movies from the library, with Seerr suggestions when the user is signed in to Seerr. Suggestions and the parental filtering of outside titles need the server-wide TMDB API key.

controls.label: Home Row Order
controls.help: Row ids in display order. Must be set together with Home Sections (a pair).

controls.label: Home Sections
controls.help: Full home layout objects. Must be set together with Home Row Order (a pair). Build it in a Moonfin client and copy the value, or leave unset.

controls.label: Video library style
controls.help: Default layout for the controls at the top of library pages. Keep Not set to let users choose.

controls.label: Book library style
controls.help: Default layout for book and audiobook libraries. Keep Not set to let users choose.

controls.label: Music library style
controls.help: Default layout for music libraries. Keep Not set to let users choose.

controls.label: Detail screen style
controls.help: Default layout for item detail pages. Keep Not set to let users choose.

controls.label: Expanded Tabs
controls.help: When on, detail screen tabs start expanded and moving focus between them reveals content without pressing select.

controls.label: Open Trailers Externally
controls.help: Play trailers in the system browser or YouTube app instead of inside Moonfin.

controls.label: Recommendation System
controls.help: Source used for recommended and similar media on detail pages.

controls.label: MDBList Ratings
controls.help: Enable MDBList ratings by default (requires server-wide or user API key).

controls.label: TMDB Episode Ratings
controls.help: Enable TMDB episode ratings by default (requires server-wide or user API key).

controls.label: Rating Sources
controls.help: Which ratings to display, in order.

controls.label: Play Theme Music on Home Rows
Action Buttons Order
controls.help: Buttons shown on detail pages, in order. Moonbase writes the same list for TV, mobile and desktop.

controls.label: Hidden Action Buttons
controls.help: Buttons hidden on detail pages (same list for all form factors).

controls.label: Metadata Row Order
controls.help: Metadata items shown on detail pages, in order (same list for all form factors).

controls.label: Hidden Metadata Items
controls.help: Metadata items hidden on detail pages (same list for all form factors).

controls.label: Resume Rewind
controls.help: Automatically rewinds slightly when resuming an in-progress video.

controls.label: Unpause Rewind
controls.help: Rewinds slightly when unpausing playback.

controls.label: Prefer External Subtitles
controls.help: What a client does when playback reaches a segment. Needs a plugin that provides segments, such as Intro Skipper. A type left unset does nothing.

controls.label: Segment Actions
controls.help: Comma-separated type:action pairs, for example "intro:skip,outro:askToSkip". Types: intro, recap, preview, commercial, outro. Actions: doNothing, skip, askToSkip. Needs a source of segments.

controls.label: Replace Skip Outro with Next Up
controls.help: Only applies when the outro asks before skipping and Next Up is on.

controls.label: Player Buttons Order
controls.help: Buttons shown around the player controls, in order. Play, pause and seek are always shown (same list for all form factors).

controls.label: Hidden Player Buttons
controls.help: Player buttons that are hidden (same list for all form factors).
